menuDescription: Choose a short guided tour. You can replay any tour at any time.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Campaign sections, search and the tour panel.

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.description: The scene book: contents, DM notes and the show dock.

show.title: Slide show
show.description: Slide decks and the scene preview.

world.title: World map
world.description: Markers, notes, nested maps and the travel log.

music.title: Music
music.description: The track library and the in-battle player.

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.description: Filters, search and cards, using spells as the example.

battle.title: Battle
battle.description: From preparation to a turn: initiative, map, actions, DM panel.

header.title: Campaign
header.description: Name, description and your role. In the demo you see the campaign as a DM, but the data is protected from changes.

notice.title: What the demo allows
notice.description: Every section is open for browsing. Battles can be started and reset; the rest of the content is read-only.

search.title: Find a section
search.description: Start typing a section name. Enter opens the first match.

group-game.title: Game
group-game.description: Scenario, scene graph, battles, slide show, music and the world map — everything you need during a session.

group-heroes.title: Heroes
group-heroes.description: Player characters: sheets, levels, gear and drafts.

group-libraries.title: Libraries
group-libraries.description: Campaign references: units, spells, artifacts, races, classes, rules. Each tile opens its own list.

tours.title: Demo tours
tours.description: Tours start here. Finished ones get a check mark, and any tour can be replayed.

summary.title: Campaign settings
summary.description: Maximum level, player edit rights, DM crit choice and other settings.

search.title: Search the scenario
search.description: Searches the text of every page: scenes and notes.

list.title: Scenario pages
list.description: Scenes are what you play at the table, notes are DM preparation. The status shows whether a page is ready. Let's open the scene.

bar.title: Page bar
bar.description: Scene title, a button to hide DM notes and a menu: theme, collapse played sections, back to the list.

toc.title: Contents
toc.description: The scene's sections. The current one is highlighted, played ones get a check mark. Click scrolls to the section.

section.title: Section
section.description: A heading with the section type icon. During play the DM marks a section as played and it collapses.

bindings.title: Show bindings
bindings.description: Text rows drive the show: a slide, a map marker or a battle is bound to a row. In a DM campaign the “Show” and “Call to battle” buttons live here; the demo hides them because the show is shared.

notes.title: DM notes
notes.description: Margin notes are visible only to the DM. Hide them with the button in the page bar.

dock.title: Show dock
dock.description: What the players see right now and the show music. In a DM campaign this also holds slide switching (N key) and the deck's slide strip.

decks.title: Slide decks
decks.description: Each deck is a sequence of slides for one scene.

deck-card.title: Deck card
deck-card.description: The slide count and the scenario scene the deck is bound to.

start.title: Start the show
start.description: This button puts the deck on the players’ show screen. It is disabled in the demo.

present.title: Open the preview
present.description: In the demo a deck opens in a private preview. Let's go there.

stage.title: Slide stage
stage.description: This is how players see the slide on the show screen: image and caption.

nav.title: Paging
nav.description: Back and next switch slides, the counter shows the position in the deck.

back.title: Back to decks
back.description: The live show for players starts from the “Show” screen — it is disabled in the demo.

header.title: “Show” button
header.description: While a live show is running, this button in the header takes players to the show screen. In the demo it is a placeholder.

crumbs.title: Map trail
crumbs.description: The world map contains nested place maps. The crumbs show where you are and lead back.

map.title: Map
map.description: Regions are labelled, points are places. Drag the map with the mouse, the wheel zooms.

marker.title: Marker
marker.description: Clicking a marker opens its panel. Let's do that now.

notes.title: Place notes
notes.description: Shared notes are visible to everyone, “Mine” only to you. Writing is disabled in the demo.

open-map.title: Nested map
open-map.description: A marker can hold its own place map — this button opens it.

zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.description: Zoom in, zoom out and reset to the initial scale.

places.title: Open places
places.description: Quick jump to the place maps you have already opened.

journal.title: Travel log
journal.description: Hero travel between places and rests are recorded here automatically.

library.title: Track library
library.description: Campaign tracks: uploaded files or YouTube links.

play.title: Listen
play.description: The button plays the track right here, a second click pauses it.

source.title: Source
source.description: A link to the original track.

battle.title: Music in battle
battle.description: The player for the party lives on the battle screen. Let's open the prepared battle.

dock.title: Player
dock.description: The music panel at the bottom left. A new turn in battle collapses it automatically.

transport.title: Controls
transport.description: Previous, play, next, stop. Volume and mute are above.

playlist.title: Playlist
playlist.description: Search the library and filter by type. Clicking a track plays it for everyone.

collapse.title: Collapse
collapse.description: The panel is collapsed into a “Music” chip — the sound keeps playing. Clicking the chip expands the player again.

filters.title: Class filter
filters.description: Chips narrow the list to one class's spells.

search.title: Search
search.description: Searches by name. Works together with the filter.

group.title: Group
group.description: Spells are grouped by school. The header collapses and expands the group and shows the count.

level.title: Level
level.description: Inside a group spells are laid out by level, from cantrips up.

card.title: Spell card
card.description: Name, level, tags and a short description. In a DM campaign the card opens the editor.

print.title: Print
print.description: A print version of the whole list.

dashboard.title: Other libraries
dashboard.description: Units, artifacts, races, classes and the rest work the same way: filters, search, cards.

list.title: Battle scenes
list.description: Active battles on top, prepared ones below. Completed ones go to the archive.

card.title: Battle card
card.description: Name, description and the open button. Let's open this battle.

arena.title: Preparation
arena.description: The sides before the start. Allies and enemies are already placed on the map.

start.title: To battle
start.description: The button rolls initiative and starts the battle. Let's start it now.

topbar.title: Top bar
topbar.description: Name, round and the animation toggle. On the right — complete, reset and next turn.

initiative.title: Initiative
initiative.description: The turn order. The large portrait is whose turn it is, a line with a Roman numeral is a new round. Click opens details.

hero.title: Participant panel
hero.description: HP, armor class and spell slots of whoever acts under your control right now.

map-tools.title: Map tools
map-tools.description: Place participants, paint terrain, pick weather. On the right — the “Map/Columns” switch.

map.title: Battle map
map.description: On your turn click a cell to move, click an enemy to attack. Clicking a token shows its details.

log.title: Log
log.description: Every battle event. With a participant selected, this shows their stat block, effects and a button back to the log.

next-turn.title: Next turn
next-turn.description: Passes the turn along the order. Next we'll advance to a unit under your control.

turn-controls.title: Actions on your turn
turn-controls.description: Attack opens the attack wizard, Magic the spell book, Bonus and Actions the abilities. End turn passes the order.

dm-actions.title: DM quick actions
dm-actions.description: Battle log, add a participant, cast a spell as anyone, refresh from the library, hand out units, buff or weaken enemies.

dm-participants.title: Participants
dm-participants.description: Each row: change HP, apply conditions, legendary actions, remove from battle.

audio.title: Music
audio.description: The battle player at the bottom left. More in the “Music” tour.

reset.title: Reset the battle
reset.description: Returns the battle to the prepared state. Press it to leave the demo clean for the next time.
